title: Birth Month Flower Market Wall Art
author: Olya.Creative
description:
🌸 Birth Month Flower Illustrations 🌸
Stunning flower market wall art style posters, perfect for any occasion! 🎨 Includes vector AI templates, Canva Template, EPS, 300 dpi PNG (transparent), and JPG. Ideal for print-on-demand: posters, t-shirts, jewelry boxes, tumblers, mugs, pillows, and more! 🌼✨ Bring your projects to life with beautiful, high-quality floral designs! 🌿🌻
Highlights for the Birth Month Flower Illustrations:
🎨 Beautiful Vector Art: Includes AI, EPS, and Canva templates for easy customization.
🖼️ High-Resolution Files: 300 dpi PNG (transparent background) + JPG, perfect for detailed prints.
🏷️ Print on Demand Ready: Ideal for posters, t-shirts, mugs, jewelry boxes, and more!
🌸 More than 24 Flower Designs: Unique, timeless illustrations for each month.
📂 Versatile & Editable: Compatible with popular design platforms for personalized projects.
🛍️ Perfect Gift Idea: Create stunning items like blankets, pillowcases, tumblers, and more!
WHAT WILL YOU GET?
══════════════════════════════════════
24 Flowers in Frames + Floral Clipart + Bonus Flowers:
• fully resizable AI and EPS vector files
• vector AI template with editable text + Frame
• Canva template with editable text + Frame
• JPG images ( 4096×4096 px ~300 dpi )
• PNG images ( ~300 dpi with transparent background )
• txt file
